Chandra Asri Group is a leading industrial company in Southeast Asia, operating through three strategic pillars, Energy & Chemicals, Integrated Infrastructure, and Mobility Solutions. Established in Indonesia in 1992, Chandra Asri Group has built a strong track record as a reliable Growth Partner to its customers and stakeholders, with strategic businesses and assets in Indonesia and Singapore, and an expanding presence in Malaysia. The Group’s asset portfolio encompasses integrated Energy & Chemicals operations, including a naphtha cracker in Cilegon with an ethylene production capacity of 0.9 million metric tons per annum, a refinery with a capacity of more than 300,000 barrels per day and a naphtha cracker with a capacity of 1.1 million metric tons per annum on Bukom Island, as well as approximately 2.5 million metric tons of downstream chemical assets on Jurong Island. Chandra Asri Group is also expanding its chemicals portfolio through the development of a world-scale chlor-alkali and ethylene dichloride facility in Cilegon. The Integrated Infrastructure pillar comprises four key areas, Power, Water, Port & Storage, and Logistics, providing essential services to support industrial activities and regional connectivity. In line with the development of its portfolio, Mobility Solutions brings the Group closer to consumers through ~60 Esso
retail service stations. For more information, visit www.chandra-asri.com.

Job Purpose

Direct and manage company’s business development team to identify and analyze business opportunities, collaborate with company’s project team and other functions as well as external parties to conduct feasibility studies, develop projects, prepare investment proposals and propose strategic recommendations to management in order to increase company value through revenue growth, cost efficiency improvement, and sustainability

Job Descriptions

• Lead and direct the Business Development team in identifying, evaluating, and prioritizing business opportunities in collaboration with relevant stakeholders to create sustainable value for the Company.
• Oversee the development and execution of proof-of-concept studies to validate the potential and feasibility of selected opportunities before progressing to the next development phase.
• Oversee detailed feasibility studies for approved concepts, ensuring comprehensive assessment of technical, commercial, financial, operational, and other relevant aspects to support informed decision-making.
• Lead the development of investment proposals, including business cases, financial analysis, reports, and management presentations, to provide robust inputs for strategic and investment decisions.
• Build and manage strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective collaboration, alignment, and timely resolution of issues throughout the business development process.
• Oversee the execution and progress of approved investment projects, ensuring alignment with the approved business case, budget, schedule, scope, and key deliverables.
• Lead, coach, and develop the Business Development team to ensure effective execution of responsibilities, high-quality deliverables, and timely achievement of business objectives.
• Establish the department's mission, objectives, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and monitor performance to ensure alignment with and achievement of the Company's strategic targets.
• Lead the department's annual planning and budgeting process, ensuring Business Development priorities, programs, and resource requirements are aligned with the Company's overall strategic direction and financial objectives.

Job Requirements

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
• Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in Business Development, preferably in a large-scale company or consulting firm.
• Proven managerial-level experience in the petrochemical/manufacturing, infrastructure, commercial, or consulting sectors.
• Strong ability to conduct and/or evaluate feasibility studies and develop financial models to support business cases and investment decisions.
• Proven experience in project management and business planning.
• Highly analytical, with the ability to analyze complex data, market trends, and business insights to support business development initiatives.
• Proven leadership capability in managing teams and delivering multiple projects in parallel.
• Demonstrated ability to develop high-quality business proposals and presentations for senior management.
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills, with fluency in English.

Important Notes
Chandra Asri is only releasing official job posting at Chandra Asri Career Site (careers.chandra-asri.com), Linkedin & Jobstreet. The Company will contact shortlisted candidate via official corporate email & phone, and will not send any hardcopy invitation for interview. Please note that the Company doesn’t ask candidates to transfer some amount of money nor cooperate with any travel agent.

Ringkasan Pekerjaan

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk sedang mencari seorang Security Officer (PS Lubuk Basung) yang terampil dan berdedikasi untuk menjaga keamanan, keselamatan, serta integritas personel, aset, dan operasional perusahaan di fasilitas Lubuk Basung. Tanggung jawab utama meliputi pengelolaan lingkungan yang aman, pemantauan area, dan penegakan protokol keselamatan kerja.

Tanggung Jawab Utama

• Pengawasan & Patroli: Melakukan penjagaan dan patroli rutin di area fasilitas Lubuk Basung guna mencegah pencurian, tindakan kriminal, pelanggaran aturan, maupun akses tanpa izin.
• KONTROL AKSES: Mengatur serta mencatat lalu lintas keluar-masuk karyawan, tamu, kendaraan, dan barang sesuai dengan prosedur standar keamanan perusahaan.
• Penanganan Keadaan Darurat: Merespons secara cepat alarm, insiden keamanan, atau situasi darurat, mengambil tindakan penanganan awal yang tepat, serta melaporkannya segera kepada manajemen.
• Inspeksi Keamanan & K3: Melakukan pemeriksaan berkala terhadap kondisi fasilitas dan peralatan keselamatan untuk memastikan kepatuhan terhadap standar K3.
• Pelaporan & Administrasi: Menyusun dan memelihara catatan log harian, laporan insiden, serta dokumentasi pergantian shift secara akurat.
• Koordinasi Eksternal: Bekerja sama dengan aparat penegak hukum setempat dan unit tanggap darurat masyarakat jika diperlukan.

Kualifikasi yang Dibutuhkan

• Pendidikan: Minimal SMA/SMK sederajat.
• Sertifikasi: Memiliki sertifikat kualifikasi satpam yang masih berlaku (diutamakan Gada Pratama).
• Pengalaman: Memiliki pengalaman kerja sebagai Security Officer, diutamakan di lingkungan industri, manufaktur, atau agribisnis.
• Karakter & Fisik: Memiliki kondisi fisik yang prima, tingkat kewaspadaan tinggi, serta integritas yang kuat.
• Kemampuan Kerja: Komunikasi yang baik dan bersedia bekerja dalam sistem shift (termasuk malam hari, akhir pekan, dan hari libur nasional).
• Penanganan Krisis: Mampu bersikap tenang, tegas, dan profesional saat menghadapi situasi darurat.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
